messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

The missing MMSC URL in your APN settings is a very common cause of MMS failure. Resetting your APN settings to the default will restore the correct MMSC URL, and this is safe—it won't delete your personal data or apps. It only resets network access settings.

Please do the following on your phone:
1. **reset_apn_settings** – This will restore the default APN settings, including the correct MMSC URL.
2. After resetting, you must **reboot_device** – Restart your phone completely so the new APN settings take effect.

Once your phone has rebooted, try sending an MMS again. If it still fails, let me know and we'll continue troubleshooting.

I have reset the APN settings to default and rebooted my phone. However, now it seems my phone shows no signal and mobile data is disabled. Should I enable the data manually? Will this affect my photos or other data on my phone? I'm quite worried about losing important photos. Please guide me carefully.

Please review the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
